_documentation.title: H4A Volleyball Team Data Backup & Source of Truth
_documentation.description: This file is a dedicated, portable backup of the team roster, fine reports, dugnad (club duty) entries, and settings. It is strictly separated from application source code. You can replace this file with exported backups from the Admin interface at any time.
_documentation.howToPopulate: 1. If your team data is already live in Firestore: Go to /admin on your site, open the 'Backup & Data' tab, and click 'Export team data'. Save that JSON file here as data/team-data.json. 2. Or manually edit the template below with your real player names, jersey numbers, positions, and history.
_documentation.howToRestore: In the Admin dashboard (/admin?key=YOUR_KEY), navigate to the 'Backup & Data' tab and use the 'Import team data' feature to safely validate and restore all players, fines, and dugnad records into Firestore.
